question: Should local-only Windows reviews intentionally drop the existing Codex Desktop fallback, or should the Desktop binary remain a fallback after explicit `CODEX_BIN` and a spawnable PATH CLI?
rationale: The PR changes a documented executable-selection contract and can stop desktop-only Windows setups from working, so the compatibility policy requires maintainer intent rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Preserve ordered fallback
options.body: Prefer `CODEX_BIN`, then a spawnable PATH CLI, and retain the Desktop binary only when neither earlier choice works.

options.title: Intentionally drop Desktop fallback
options.body: Accept the compatibility break, document the migration requirement, and require native Windows proof for PATH-only operation.

recommendation.title: Preserve ordered fallback
recommendation.body: Prefer `CODEX_BIN`, then a spawnable PATH CLI, and retain the Desktop binary only when neither earlier choice works.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice governs the repository's local-review operator contract and belongs with the central ClawSweeper orchestration owner.
